target: released composed three-class label, unknown 255 retained
primary_method_comparison: same native pixels within each reference policy
primary_policy_comparison: harmonized P0 versus P1 on identical joint radar-valid labeled pixels
delivered_p0_role: full released-cohort assessment; do not subtract it from harmonized P1
overlap_priority: ascending absolute post-SAR to label-time difference, then full tile key; no prediction scores used
overlap_operation: earlier eligible coverage owns an overlapping pixel center; nearest-neighbor native-grid coverage reprojection handles UTM-zone overlaps
primary_average: average source-seed IoU within activation, average activations within conservative episode blocks, equally average blocks
episode_qualification: The two overlapping Iberian activation periods are conservatively one resampling block, not asserted to be one meteorological storm. Also report all activation results, activation-balanced means and leave-one-block-out changes. Other cross-event dependence remains possible.
uncertainty: 9999 paired episode-block bootstrap draws with seed 20261111; training-seed spread shown separately; eight blocks limit precision
sensitivities: released source-mask label composition on originally known support
remove one 10-m pixel around class boundaries
zero_union: undefined IoU when neither reference nor prediction has flood; retain false alarms and coverage
area: nominal 10-m native pixels; area totals across released records are not unique regional flood area
claims: reference-map agreement; timing mismatch and reused reference products limit interpretation as simultaneous ground truth
scope: fixed trained models and existing targets only; no target fitting or revised image selection
